fullText.simplified:
第5章、我要工作

    高尔没有把门打开，马经理很生气，他说不能把工作交给高尔。
    高尔害怕极了，马经理的话，意思是他不想要高尔了！高尔大叫着爬向门边，他还是只能发出让人听不太清楚的“嗯嗯”声。
    马经理越来越生气，爸爸更生气，他用力敲门，大叫：“高尔！马上开门！”
    高尔爬到了门把手上，用力，用力，再用力……门开了一点儿。
    高尔爬在门把手上，大声叫着：“您别生气，请听我解释！我需要这份工作！没有工作，我就没有工资了！没有工资，我的家人们就不能好好生活了！”
    爸爸、妈妈、马经理和妹妹都站在门外，他们看到了门把手上的高尔，一个个都睁大了眼睛、张大了嘴。妹妹大叫一声，像是看到了什么可怕的东西。妈妈的脸白了，她后退着坐在了一把椅子上。爸爸的眼睛睁得最大，他不敢相信地说：“这是什么东西？”
    马经理也被吓到了。他后退了好几步，然后像是明白了，马上向楼下走去。他要离开。
    高尔大叫着爬过去：“马经理，您别生气！我要工作！请等等我！”
    马经理听到他的叫声后，跑了起来，他没有说“再见”就飞快地从这个家里离开了。
    高尔还在着急地往外面爬。爸爸已经完全看清楚了高尔的样子。他扬起手里的手杖，让高尔回房间。高尔看到了爸爸生气的脸和他扬起的手杖，他有些吃惊，不敢爬了。
    “回去！”爸爸大声说。
    高尔向房间爬去。他爬得有些慢，而且刚刚从床上摔下来的时候，他的腿摔疼了，所以现在就爬得更慢了。但爸爸好像不能再等了，他的手杖向高尔扬了过来。
    “砰”的一声，手杖敲在了高尔的腿和背上。高尔向房间里飞了去，肚子撞到书桌后再重重地摔在了地面上。
    疼！太疼了！高尔晕了过去。
    “砰”又是一声响，爸爸重重地把房门关上了。
fullText.traditional:
第5章、我要工作

    高爾沒有把門打開，馬經理很生氣，他說不能把工作交給高爾。
    高爾害怕極了，馬經理的話，意思是他不想要高爾了！高爾大叫著爬向門邊，他還是只能發出讓人聽不太清楚的“嗯嗯”聲。
    馬經理越來越生氣，爸爸更生氣，他用力敲門，大叫：“高爾！馬上開門！”
    高爾爬到了門把手上，用力，用力，再用力……門開了一點兒。
    高爾爬在門把手上，大聲叫著：“您別生氣，請聽我解釋！我需要這份工作！沒有工作，我就沒有工資了！沒有工資，我的家人們就不能好好生活了！”
    爸爸、媽媽、馬經理和妹妹都站在門外，他們看到了門把手上的高爾，一個個都睜大了眼睛、張大了嘴。妹妹大叫一聲，像是看到了什麼可怕的東西。媽媽的臉白了，她後退著坐在了一把椅子上。爸爸的眼睛睜得最大，他不敢相信地說：“這是什麼東西？”
    馬經理也被嚇到了。他後退了好幾步，然後像是明白了，馬上向樓下走去。他要離開。
    高爾大叫著爬過去：“馬經理，您別生氣！我要工作！請等等我！”
    馬經理聽到他的叫聲後，跑了起來，他沒有說“再見”就飛快地從這個家裡離開了。
    高爾還在著急地往外面爬。爸爸已經完全看清楚了高爾的樣子。他揚起手裡的手杖，讓高爾回房間。高爾看到了爸爸生氣的臉和他揚起的手杖，他有些吃驚，不敢爬了。
    “回去！”爸爸大聲說。
    高爾向房間爬去。他爬得有些慢，而且剛剛從床上摔下來的時候，他的腿摔疼了，所以現在就爬得更慢了。但爸爸好像不能再等了，他的手杖向高爾揚了過來。
    “砰”的一聲，手杖敲在了高爾的腿和背上。高爾向房間裡飛了去，肚子撞到書桌後再重重地摔在了地面上。
    疼！太疼了！高爾暈了過去。
    “砰”又是一聲響，爸爸重重地把房門關上了。

sentences.traditional: 高爾沒有把門打開，馬經理很生氣，他說不能把工作交給高爾。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr méi yǒu bǎ mén dǎ kāi mǎ jīng lǐ hěn shēng qì tā shuō bù néng bǎ gōng zuò jiāo gěi gāo ěr

sentences.simplified: 高尔害怕极了，马经理的话，意思是他不想要高尔了！
sentences.traditional: 高爾害怕極了，馬經理的話，意思是他不想要高爾了！
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr hài pà jí le mǎ jīng lǐ de huà yì si shì tā bù xiǎng yào gāo ěr le
sentences.english: Gao Er was extremely scared. Manager Ma’s words meant that he didn’t want Gao Er anymore!

sentences.simplified: 高尔大叫着爬向门边，他还是只能发出让人听不太清楚的“嗯嗯”声。
sentences.traditional: 高爾大叫著爬向門邊，他還是只能發出讓人聽不太清楚的“嗯嗯”聲。

sentences.english: Gao Er crawled toward the door, yelling, but he could still only make indistinct “hmm hmm” sounds.

sentences.simplified: 马经理越来越生气，爸爸更生气，
sentences.traditional: 馬經理越來越生氣，爸爸更生氣，
sentences.pinyin: mǎ jīng lǐ yuè lái yuè shēng qì bà ba gèng shēng qì
sentences.english: Manager Ma was getting angrier and angrier. His father was even angrier.

sentences.simplified: 他用力敲门，大叫：“高尔！马上开门！”
sentences.traditional: 他用力敲門，大叫：“高爾！馬上開門！”
sentences.pinyin: tā yòng lì qiāo mén dà jiào gāo ěr mǎ shàng kāi mén
sentences.english: He banged on the door hard, shouting, “Gao Er! Open the door immediately!”

sentences.simplified: 高尔爬到了门把手上，用力，用力，再用力……门开了一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 高爾爬到了門把手上，用力，用力，再用力……門開了一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr pá dào le mén bǎ shou shang yòng lì yòng lì zài yòng lì mén kāi le yì diǎn'r
sentences.english: Gao Er crawled onto the door handle. He pushed hard, pushed harder, and even harder … The door opened a little bit.

sentences.simplified: 高尔爬在门把手上，大声叫着：“您别生气，请听我解释！
sentences.traditional: 高爾爬在門把手上，大聲叫著：“您別生氣，請聽我解釋！
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr pá zài mén bǎ shou shang dà shēng jiào zhe nín bié shēng qì qǐng tīng wǒ jiě shì
sentences.english: Gao Er was crawling on the door handle. He shouted loudly, “Don’t be angry, please allow me to explain!

sentences.simplified: 我需要这份工作！没有工作，我就没有工资了！没有工资，我的家人们就不能好好生活了！”
sentences.traditional: 我需要這份工作！沒有工作，我就沒有工資了！沒有工資，我的家人們就不能好好生活了！”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xū yào zhè fèn gōng zuò méi yǒu gōng zuò wǒ jiù méi yǒu gōng zī le méi yǒu gōng zī wǒ de jiā rén men jiù bù néng hǎo hǎo shēng huó le
sentences.english: I need this job! If I don’t have a job, I won’t have a salary! Without a salary, my family can’t live well!”

sentences.simplified: 爸爸、妈妈、马经理和妹妹都站在门外，
sentences.traditional: 爸爸、媽媽、馬經理和妹妹都站在門外，
sentences.pinyin: bà ba mā ma mǎ jīng lǐ hé mèi mei dōu zhàn zài mén wài
sentences.english: His father, mother, Manager Ma, and little sister were all standing outside the door.

sentences.simplified: 他们看到了门把手上的高尔，一个个都睁大了眼睛、张大了嘴。
sentences.traditional: 他們看到了門把手上的高爾，一個個都睜大了眼睛、張大了嘴。
sentences.pinyin: tā men kàn dào le mén bǎ shou shang de gāo ěr yí gè gè dōu zhēng dà le yǎn jing zhāng dà le zuǐ
sentences.english: They saw Gao Er on the door handle, and one by one, their eyes widened, and their mouths opened.

sentences.simplified: 妹妹大叫一声，像是看到了什么可怕的东西。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹大叫一聲，像是看到了什麼可怕的東西。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei dà jiào yì shēng xiàng shì kàn dào le shén me kě pà de dōng xi
sentences.english: His little sister screamed, as if she had seen something terrifying.

sentences.simplified: 妈妈的脸白了，她后退着坐在了一把椅子上。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽的臉白了，她後退著坐在了一把椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma de liǎn bái le tā hòu tuì zhe zuò zài le yì bǎ yǐ zi shang
sentences.english: His mother’s face turned pale. She stepped back and sat down in a chair.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸的眼睛睁得最大，他不敢相信地说：“这是什么东西？”
sentences.traditional: 爸爸的眼睛睜得最大，他不敢相信地說：“這是什麼東西？”
sentences.pinyin: bà ba de yǎn jing zhēng de zuì dà tā bù gǎn xiāng xìn de shuō zhè shì shén me dōng xi
sentences.english: His father’s eyes were open the widest. He said incredulously, “What is this thing?”

sentences.simplified: 马经理也被吓到了。
sentences.traditional: 馬經理也被嚇到了。
sentences.pinyin: mǎ jīng lǐ yě bèi xià dào le
sentences.english: Manager Ma was also scared.

sentences.simplified: 他后退了好几步，然后像是明白了，马上向楼下走去。他要离开。
sentences.traditional: 他後退了好幾步，然後像是明白了，馬上向樓下走去。他要離開。
sentences.pinyin: tā hòu tuì le hǎo jǐ bù rán hòu xiàng shì míng bai le mǎ shàng xiàng lóu xià zǒu qù tā yào lí kāi
sentences.english: He took several steps back. Then he seemed to understand and immediately walked downstairs. He wanted to leave.

sentences.simplified: 高尔大叫着爬过去：“马经理，您别生气！我要工作！请等等我！”
sentences.traditional: 高爾大叫著爬過去：“馬經理，您別生氣！我要工作！請等等我！”
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr dà jiào zhe pá guò qu mǎ jīng lǐ nín bié shēng qì wǒ yào gōng zuò qǐng děng děng wǒ
sentences.english: Gao Er shouted as he crawled over, “Manager Ma, don’t be angry! I must work! Please wait for me!”

sentences.simplified: 马经理听到他的叫声后，跑了起来，他没有说“再见”就飞快地从这个家里离开了。
sentences.traditional: 馬經理聽到他的叫聲後，跑了起來，他沒有說“再見”就飛快地從這個家裡離開了。
sentences.pinyin: mǎ jīng lǐ tīng dào tā de jiào shēng hòu pǎo le qǐ lái tā méi yǒu shuō zài jiàn jiù fēi kuài de cóng zhè ge jiā lǐ lí kāi le
sentences.english: Manager Ma began to run after hearing Gao Er’s cries and left the house quickly without saying “goodbye”.

sentences.simplified: 高尔还在着急地往外面爬。爸爸已经完全看清楚了高尔的样子。
sentences.traditional: 高爾還在著急地往外面爬。爸爸已經完全看清楚了高爾的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr hái zài zháo jí de wǎng wài miàn pá bà ba yǐ jīng wán quán kàn qīng chu le gāo ěr de yàng zi
sentences.english: Gao Er was still anxiously trying to crawl out. His father had already gotten a good look at him.

sentences.simplified: 他扬起手里的手杖，让高尔回房间。
sentences.traditional: 他揚起手裡的手杖，讓高爾回房間。
sentences.pinyin: tā yáng qǐ shǒu lǐ de shǒu zhàng ràng gāo ěr huí fáng jiān
sentences.english: He raised the cane in his hand, telling Gao Er to go back to his room.

sentences.simplified: 高尔看到了爸爸生气的脸和他扬起的手杖，他有些吃惊，不敢爬了。
sentences.traditional: 高爾看到了爸爸生氣的臉和他揚起的手杖，他有些吃驚，不敢爬了。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr kàn dào le bà ba shēng qì de liǎn hé tā yáng qǐ de shǒu zhàng tā yǒu xiē chī jīng bù gǎn pá le
sentences.english: Gao Er saw his father’s angry face and the raised cane. He was a little startled and didn’t dare to crawl anymore.

sentences.simplified: “回去！”爸爸大声说。
sentences.traditional: “回去！”爸爸大聲說。
sentences.pinyin: huí qù bà ba dà shēng shuō
sentences.english: “Go back!” his father said loudly.

sentences.simplified: 高尔向房间爬去。
sentences.traditional: 高爾向房間爬去。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr xiàng fáng jiān pá qù
sentences.english: Gao Er crawled toward his room.

sentences.simplified: 他爬得有些慢，而且刚刚从床上摔下来的时候，他的腿摔疼了，所以现在就爬得更慢了。
sentences.traditional: 他爬得有些慢，而且剛剛從床上摔下來的時候，他的腿摔疼了，所以現在就爬得更慢了。
sentences.pinyin: tā pá de yǒu xiē màn ér qiě gāng gang cóng chuáng shang shuāi xià lái de shí hou tā de tuǐ shuāi téng le suǒ yǐ xiàn zài jiù pá de gèng màn le
sentences.english: He crawled somewhat slowly, and when he fell off the bed just now, he hurt his leg, so now he crawled even more slowly.

sentences.simplified: 但爸爸好像不能再等了，他的手杖向高尔扬了过来。
sentences.traditional: 但爸爸好像不能再等了，他的手杖向高爾揚了過來。
sentences.pinyin: dàn bà ba hǎo xiàng bù néng zài děng le tā de shǒu zhàng xiàng gāo ěr yáng le guò lái
sentences.english: But it seemed like his father couldn’t wait any longer. His cane was raised toward Gao Er.

sentences.simplified: “砰”的一声，手杖敲在了高尔的腿和背上。
sentences.traditional: “砰”的一聲，手杖敲在了高爾的腿和背上。
sentences.pinyin: pēng de yì shēng shǒu zhàng qiāo zài le gāo ěr de tuǐ hé bèi shang
sentences.english: With a “bang”, the cane struck Gao Er’s legs and back.

sentences.simplified: 高尔向房间里飞了去，肚子撞到书桌后再重重地摔在了地面上。
sentences.traditional: 高爾向房間裡飛了去，肚子撞到書桌後再重重地摔在了地面上。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr xiàng fáng jiān lǐ fēi le qù dù zi zhuàng dào shū zhuō hòu zài zhòng zhòng de shuāi zài le dì miàn shang
sentences.english: Gao Er went flying into his room, his stomach hitting the desk before he fell heavily onto the ground.

sentences.simplified: 疼！太疼了！高尔晕了过去。
sentences.traditional: 疼！太疼了！高爾暈了過去。
sentences.pinyin: téng tài téng le gāo ěr yūn le guò qù
sentences.english: Ouch! It hurt so much! Gao Er fainted.

sentences.simplified: “砰”又是一声响，爸爸重重地把房门关上了。
sentences.traditional: “砰”又是一聲響，爸爸重重地把房門關上了。
sentences.pinyin: pēng yòu shì yì shēng xiǎng bà ba zhòng zhòng de bǎ fáng mén guān shàng le
sentences.english: With another “bang”, his father slammed the door heavily.

sentence_translations: Chapter 5: I Must Work
Gao Er didn’t open the door. Manager Ma was very angry, and he said he couldn’t give work to Gao Er.
Gao Er was extremely scared. Manager Ma’s words meant that he didn’t want Gao Er anymore!
Gao Er crawled toward the door, yelling, but he could still only make indistinct “hmm hmm” sounds.
Manager Ma was getting angrier and angrier. His father was even angrier.
He banged on the door hard, shouting, “Gao Er! Open the door immediately!”
Gao Er crawled onto the door handle. He pushed hard, pushed harder, and even harder … The door opened a little bit.
Gao Er was crawling on the door handle. He shouted loudly, “Don’t be angry, please allow me to explain!
I need this job! If I don’t have a job, I won’t have a salary! Without a salary, my family can’t live well!”
His father, mother, Manager Ma, and little sister were all standing outside the door.
They saw Gao Er on the door handle, and one by one, their eyes widened, and their mouths opened.
His little sister screamed, as if she had seen something terrifying.
His mother’s face turned pale. She stepped back and sat down in a chair.
His father’s eyes were open the widest. He said incredulously, “What is this thing?”
Manager Ma was also scared.
He took several steps back. Then he seemed to understand and immediately walked downstairs. He wanted to leave.
Gao Er shouted as he crawled over, “Manager Ma, don’t be angry! I must work! Please wait for me!”
Manager Ma began to run after hearing Gao Er’s cries and left the house quickly without saying “goodbye”.
Gao Er was still anxiously trying to crawl out. His father had already gotten a good look at him.
He raised the cane in his hand, telling Gao Er to go back to his room.
Gao Er saw his father’s angry face and the raised cane. He was a little startled and didn’t dare to crawl anymore.
“Go back!” his father said loudly.
Gao Er crawled toward his room.
He crawled somewhat slowly, and when he fell off the bed just now, he hurt his leg, so now he crawled even more slowly.
But it seemed like his father couldn’t wait any longer. His cane was raised toward Gao Er.
With a “bang”, the cane struck Gao Er’s legs and back.
Gao Er went flying into his room, his stomach hitting the desk before he fell heavily onto the ground.
Ouch! It hurt so much! Gao Er fainted.
With another “bang”, his father slammed the door heavily.
